description: This file contains platform-specific functions for upgrading firmware images, including partition detection, image validation, and upgrade procedures for a specific embedded system platform.

methods.name: platform_find_partitions
methods.description: Detects and outputs partition information from /proc/mtd, identifying key partitions like kernel and rootfs.

methods.name: platform_find_kernelpart
methods.description: Finds the kernel partition name from a provided partition string.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the integrity of a firmware image by checking its checksum and magic word.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade by writing the new image to the appropriate partitions after validation.
